categories.main_business_segments: Chia Her Industrial Co., Ltd primarily operates in the textile industry, including spinning, weaving, dyeing and finishing, and garment manufacturing. The company also engages in manufacturing for automotive textiles, medical devices, and other industrial products. Additionally, it has business segments in wholesale and retail of textiles, apparel, chemicals, medical equipment, and real estate development and leasing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes integrated production processes from yarn design and development, spinning, weaving, dyeing, finishing to post-processing. It emphasizes functional textile technologies such as functional processing, memory-shaped metallic yarns, wicking fibers, chitosan fibers, bamboo charcoal, Coolmax, and eco-friendly recycled polyester. Advanced spinning technologies include Sirospun, Sirofil, and Compact yarns, with innovations in jacquard, elastic fibers, and environmentally sustainable materials.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Chia Her serves global customers in sportswear, outdoor, leisure, fashion apparel, automotive textiles, and home furnishings. Its products are marketed to international garment brands and distributors, with a focus on high-value-added functional textiles. The company targets both domestic and overseas markets, including Hong Kong, Asia, the Americas, Europe, and emerging markets such as Eastern Europe, Middle East, and Latin America.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan with production bases in Tainan City and sales offices in Taipei. It exports approximately 80% of its finished fabrics internationally, with key export destinations including Hong Kong, Asia, the US, Canada, and Europe. The company is expanding its presence in emerging markets such as Eastern Europe, Middle East, and Latin America, while maintaining a strong domestic market presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: Chia Her operates primarily in the midstream segment of the textile supply chain, encompassing yarn spinning, weaving, dyeing, finishing, and fabric manufacturing. It also extends downstream into garment manufacturing and automotive textile applications. The company integrates upstream raw material sourcing and collaborates closely with international raw material suppliers for product development.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in functional and eco-friendly textiles, including bamboo charcoal, organic cotton, recycled polyester, and advanced fiber blends. It focuses on developing high-value-added products such as sports, outdoor, fire-resistant, and automotive textiles. The R&D center emphasizes innovation in spinning technologies, sustainable dyeing processes, brand promotion, and intellectual property development. Future plans include expanding automotive textile products and constructing a smart, energy-efficient new factory.
categories.revenue_model: Chia Her generates revenue primarily through product sales of yarns, fabrics, and finished textile products. It also earns income from real estate development and leasing activities. The company supplies to international brands and distributors on a B2B basis, providing customized and value-added textile solutions. Revenue streams include domestic sales, exports, and expanding automotive textile product lines.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company faces competition from textile manufacturers in China, Southeast Asia, Korea, and Turkey, which benefit from lower labor costs and industry clustering. Chia Her positions itself as a leading Taiwanese textile manufacturer focusing on high-value, differentiated functional fabrics and integrated production capabilities. It leverages advanced technology, sustainable materials, and strong global marketing channels to maintain competitiveness against low-cost producers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Chia Her reported operating revenue of approximately NT$2.89 billion, representing an 8.92% growth over the previous year. Net profit increased by 23.41% to NT$93 million, with a net profit margin of 3.22%. The company has a total asset base exceeding NT$6.4 billion and equity of about NT$2 billion, showing steady growth and improved profitability. It continues to invest in R&D and capital expenditures, including a new smart factory project expected to complete in late 2026.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Chia Her emphasizes product innovation with functional, eco-friendly, and high-performance textiles tailored to global brand needs. Its vertically integrated production ensures quality control and flexibility, enabling rapid response to market trends. The company differentiates through advanced fiber technologies, sustainable materials, comprehensive certifications, and strong customer service. Its strategic focus on automotive textiles and smart manufacturing aims to enhance profitability and long-term sustainability.
